decisions.reason: Changing the Power Board's mounted orientation does not alter the active three-board architecture.
The requirement that the battery remain pluggable in the mounted orientation remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a new connector-interface value.
The mechanical orientation change does not affect the battery protection, cutoff, or thermal-sensing requirements.
The Power Board orientation does not change the charge-status indication path on the Main Board.
The board mounting orientation has no entailed effect on ESP32 clock, sleep, or wake behavior.
The source does not change I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The mechanical orientation change does not alter the switched 5V rail's control, default state, purpose, or operating pattern.
Mention of a possible screw-secured support does not change the established component or connector sourceability policy.
